forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M246
do not loosen the protected-key guard
do not proceed with another M243-style combined-only outcome loss
hypothesis: M243 regressed the protected-key source because the PPO auxiliary objective and gate treated the combined M232 corpus as one surface. A bounded repair should separate protected-key non-regression from broad M223 improvement before any new PPO.
success_criteria: identify why the current M243 training objective can improve M223 while regressing protected-key source
choose one bounded training repair that can be implemented and tested
pre-register lexicographic exact gate criteria for the next PPO candidate
keep M239 alpha 0.5 as current public-gate base
failure_criteria: run PPO before choosing a bounded repair
use M223-only improvement as a continuation criterion

commands.name: m246_design
commands.command: Use M245 source-aware outputs and the M243 PPO config to design the next source-balanced outcome-loss repair.

decision_rule: M246 may unblock implementation only if it selects one source-aware repair and pre-registers exact source gates before any new PPO.

rejected_repairs: use M223-only improvement as continuation criterion
increase combined M232 coefficient without source separation

next_blocker: Implement source-balanced outcome losses before PPO.
